title: BayesBreak: Generalized Hierarchical Bayesian Segmentation
description: BayesBreak is a Python library for offline Bayesian segmentation. It supports irregular designs, multi-sequence shared-boundary pooling, grouped and latent-group templates, exact conjugate inference, and explicitly approximate nonconjugate block calculations with certified perturbation bounds. All E00–E10 confirmatory experiments pass their execution gates.
notes: This software release corresponds to arXiv preprint arXiv:2603.14681. E09 (real-data analysis) passed its execution gate but 25 of 31 protocol cells are truncated at their declared k_max; the unrestricted MAP segment counts for those cells are unknown.
